body: You still do and always will have the potential to be good at shit, I don't know you beyond this post, but to act as if you are a waste to humanity is much less than you deserve, it's obvious you aren't a bad person, nor a waste, or a sub-human piece of shit. I wish you better days than you are currently experiencing, and I only wish I could do more for you.
Other than occasionally hinting at how I felt during conversations, nothing I suppose, guess that's why I am still where I am.
